newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria plans credit scheme for small firms.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria plans credit scheme for small firms.

text.p: Nigeria plans to set up a National Credit Guarantee Scheme (NCGS) to provide loan facilities for small and medium enterprises, the national news agency reported on Tuesday.

"The scheme will take over from the banks and other financial institutions the risks inherent in lending to small and medium enterprises," industries minister Lieutenant-General Balarabe Haladu said at a seminar in the capital Abuja.
Haladu said in spite of arrangements by the government to provide loans for development of small and medium-scale firms, people still found it difficult to access funds to set up such ventures.
Financial institutions were unwilling to grant credit facilities to the firms because they were risk-prone due to lack of collateral, he said.
"The establishment of the NCGS will allay the fears and reservations by financial houses," he said.
